name: task
description: Spawn a sub-agent on a focused prompt. Prefer background=true for parallel work, then task_wait. Foreground tasks follow the current parent turn and are cancelled if that turn is interrupted; set background=true when the parent may receive new input or close. Raise max_steps for multi-file explores (default is higher than parent chat but still finite). Ask the child to finish with a short written report before the step budget ends.

prompt.description: Full instructions for the sub-agent (include: write a final summary before stopping)

description.description: Short label shown in the UI

name.description: Optional stable name for the job

model_class.description: Optional strength class from the orchestration plan: flash or pro

max_steps.description: Child tool-round budget (0 = config default, typically 1000). Use 48-64 for large audits.

background.description: If true, return immediately while the job runs (recommended for parallel agents)
